content: {"reasoning":"The primary payer denied the service as bundled under CO-97, and both available clinical review paths—peer-to-peer and formal appeal—have already been attempted without payment. Resubmission would not address the adjudication, and a contractual bundling denial should not be transferred to the patient; because active secondary coverage exists and COB order is correct, the balance should now be submitted to the secondary payer.","action":"bill_secondary"}
